title: Orientation Slate: Capacity fallback variants and quick-setup tiles
creator: Aisha Martinez
description: Produce a compact onboarding 'orientation slate' asset set that conveys capacity setup, autoscaling behaviors, and SLA fallback variants. Deliver hero and card-sized visuals, micro-interaction animations, annotated screenshots for docs, and a microcopy guide for the quickstart flow.
acceptance_criteria: Six slate variants produced: small/startup, medium/growth, large/enterprise, and each with an alternate 'with burst' visual.
Exports: hero (1200x600) and card (420x240) at @2x and @3x; Lottie animations + MP4 fallbacks delivered.
Copy reviewed and approved by PM; tooltip text under 140 characters per tile.
Accessibility pass: color contrast AA and keyboard-focus prototypes validated.
Assets uploaded to Figma and Drive; file links added to ticket attachments.
comments: 2026-02-22 Marcus Chen: Initial sketches uploaded to Figma; focused on three personas (startup, scale, enterprise) and two capacity modes (reserved, burst).
2026-02-26 Aisha Martinez: PM review — prefer clearer visual separation between reserved and burst; add SLA percentile badge to each persona tile.
2026-03-02 Marcus Chen: Prototype for deferred-autoscale animation attached; suggested shorter easing and a 600ms delay before burst kicks in.
2026-03-05 Riley Park (PM): Copy suggestions — change 'Burst' to 'On-demand burst' and add tooltip: 'Temporary extra capacity billed at on-demand rate.'
2026-03-07 Jordan Patel (Eng): Confirmed Lottie is acceptable; engineering will add MP4 fallback for email/docs where JS is restricted.
2026-03-09 Nora Singh (Accessibility): Contrast pass needed for secondary badge; recommended bolder icon strokes for low-vision users.
2026-03-10 Aisha Martinez: Merged final copy into docs branch and uploaded PNG exports; requesting design review sign-off and handoff checklist.
decisions: Use the orientation-slate as the onboarding hero in the quickstart modal instead of a stepper to reduce perceived complexity.
Expose three capacity personas with explicit SLA badges: 99.9% (Standard), 99.95% (Premium), 99.99% (Enterprise).
Implement animations as Lottie with MP4 fallbacks; provide static PNGs for air-gapped/private installs.
Microcopy will avoid technical latency numbers; instead use human-readable descriptors and a link to the SLA docs.
followups: Create ENG handoff: wire animation triggers and Lottie integration (ENG-41290).
Run A/B test comparing orientation-slate hero vs stepper on onboarding completion rate (PM-2783).
Prepare localized microcopy for FR/DE/JP prior to release.
notes: Edge case: For on-prem/private deployments with limited client-side rendering, substitute animations with annotated static imagery and include an explicit note about offline upgrade paths.
